intro: Trying to apply before opportunities close is the whole point of this USA scholarship filter: it pulls together a focused set of listings with deadline text already in view, so you can find options that may need attention soon. The programs below span areas such as education, community, STEM, arts, medicine, and other miscellaneous categories, with examples that reach from high school seniors to graduate students and adult non-traditional applicants. ScholarshipTop structures award details by listing so you can prioritize urgent next steps, and deadlines differ by program rather than following one shared cutoff. Requirements also vary, including whether an essay is needed, so it makes sense to compare each row carefully instead of assuming the same application workload across the list.
